title: to_currency reads 0.01-0.09 as 10-90 paisa (leading zero lost)
property: the paisa part of 'T.PP' is spoken as the integer PP
evidence: parse_paisa does int('01')*100 -> '10'; 1 paisa = 0.01 taka. Docstring example 9999.15 -> পনের পয়সা shows the two decimals are paisa.

title: to_cardinal drops zeros after the decimal point (1.05 reads as 1.5)
property: every digit after the decimal point is spoken, including leading zeros
expected: a reading different from 1.5 (e.g. এক দশমিক শূন্য পাঁচ)
evidence: parse_number converts the fractional string with int(), discarding leading zeros; _dosomik_to_bengali_word reads digit by digit, so the intent is digit-wise reading. 1.05 and 1.5 are different numbers.
